functional_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM members
SELECT email, full_name, joined_on FROM members

functional_queries.description: Catalogo dei libri e categoria per chiave ISBN
functional_queries.sql: SELECT b.isbn, b.title, b.author, c.name AS category_name FROM books b JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = b.category_id

functional_queries.description: Prestiti osservabili senza associazione al libro non fornita
functional_queries.sql: SELECT m.email, l.loan_date, l.due_date FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.member_id = l.member_id
SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS book_count FROM books b JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = b.category_id GROUP BY c.name

functional_queries.description: Numero di prestiti per membro con almeno un prestito
functional_queries.sql: SELECT m.email, COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.member_id = l.member_id GROUP BY m.email
SELECT m.email, l.loan_date, l.due_date, CAST(julianday(l.due_date) - julianday(l.loan_date) AS INTEGER) AS duration_days FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.member_id = l.member_id
SELECT name AS category_name FROM categories
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM loans
SELECT COUNT(*) AS book_count FROM books
